Attached: 1 image

Here’s Boxcar, my new free app that shows the status of your Docker containers and lets you start and stop them and tail their logs.

It’s a tiny Mac menu bar app in the spirit of Classic Mac OS Desk Accessories.

* Built with Claude. I care about getting Mac UX right. Read the README before you @ me.

https://github.com/natesilva/boxcar

#apple #macos #docker
